name: 里拉鳐
description: 里拉鳐的体表能够分泌并牵连出细长的粘液，这些粘液对水流变化极其敏感，能帮助它判断水流方向。游动时，水流掠过粘液弦会引发持续振动，发出琴音。一般认为雄性的气孔粘液更少，形成的琴弦更细，因此琴声更清脆明亮。
descriptionEn: Lilayao’s body surface can secrete and draw out long, slender strands of mucus. These strands are extremely sensitive to changes in the water flow and help it judge the direction of the current. As it swims, water passing over the mucus strings sets off continuous vibrations that produce lyre-like tones. It is generally believed that males have less mucus in their spiracles, forming thinner strings, so their tones are crisper and brighter.

skills.name: 水弹
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 洗礼
skills.description: 驱散自己的减益，并获得全技能能耗-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels self debuffs and gains all-skill energy cost -1.

skills.name: 泡沫
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 晒太阳
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels all buffs on the enemy.

skills.name: 水幕冲击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.
